note: Server-side verification of a code verifier against a stored challenge (RFC 7636 section 4.6). Every challenge in this file was derived by the transform under test; the rejection corpus covers wrong challenges, tampered challenges, wrong encodings, swapped arguments, out-of-range verifiers and method substitution.

an empty verifier carries no entropy; RFC 7636 section 4.1 requires 43-128 characters
cases.deviation: RFC 7636 section 4.1 fixes the verifier syntax at 43-128 characters from the unreserved set, and section 4.6 requires the server to validate what it receives; upstream's verifyChallenge only re-derives the challenge and compares, so it accepts a verifier the RFC forbids. pkce.Verify checks the syntax first and refuses. Upstream is the outlier and the looser side, so the port keeps its check
